        }

    static long[] longs(Scanner scanner) {
        String[] line = scanner.nextLine().split(" ");
        long[] longs = new long[line.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < line.length; i++) longs[i] = Long.parseLong(line[i]);
        return longs;
    }
